Intake Implementation Pattern

The System Handles Intake, A Person Approves The Next Step

The automation model pauses before anything important is confirmed. The system qualifies the lead and drafts a next action, then a person approves, edits, or rejects it.

AEO Studio

Turn Search Questions Into Buyer And Recruit Leads

Built to attract insurance consumers and strong sales agent candidates.

Insurance Buyers

Questions That Can Pull In Consumers

Consumer Leads
Search Question

How Much Life Insurance Should A Young Family Consider?

Start with income replacement, mortgage or rent, debts, childcare, education goals, and how long loved ones may need support. A licensed professional should review personal details before any policy decision.

Search Question

What Is Mortgage Protection Life Insurance?

Mortgage protection is commonly discussed as coverage intended to help loved ones keep up with or resolve mortgage obligations if the insured person dies.

Search Question

What Happens During A Life Insurance Consultation?

A consultation usually reviews goals, budget, family responsibilities, existing coverage, and next steps. Quotes or applications should stay with licensed professionals.

Sales Agent Recruiting

Questions That Can Attract Better Agents

Recruit Leads
Search Question

How Do You Become A Life Insurance Sales Agent?

Most candidates need to review state requirements, complete required education, pass the licensing exam, and complete agency or carrier onboarding.

Search Question

What Should A New Agent Ask Before Joining An Agency?

Ask about training, lead support, mentorship, compensation, compliance review, carrier access, and what happens after a prospect requests information.

Search Question

Can Insurance Sales Be Part Time?

Some agencies support part-time starts, but candidates should confirm licensing, schedule expectations, lead handling, supervision, and production requirements.
